senses.zh_definition: 令人愉快或满意的；不错的；做得好的。
senses.en_definition: Pleasant, satisfactory, attractive, or well done.
senses.ms_definition: Menyenangkan, memuaskan, menarik, atau dilakukan dengan baik.
senses.nuances: 英语常用评价词；马来语对应词须随对象选择，如 bagus、cantik、menyenangkan。以下为编辑释义，并非 DBP 原文。[Merriam-Webster: nice](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/nice)

senses.zh_definition: 待人友善、体贴或有礼貌的。
senses.en_definition: Kind, considerate, or polite towards others.
senses.ms_definition: Baik hati, bertimbang rasa, atau sopan terhadap orang lain.
senses.nuances: nice 描述人的待人方式时不等于“漂亮”；正式评价宜说明具体优点。[Merriam-Webster: nice](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/nice)

senses.zh_definition: 精细的；需要细致辨别或精确处理的。
senses.en_definition: Fine, subtle, or requiring careful discrimination or precision.
senses.ms_definition: Halus atau memerlukan penelitian dan ketepatan yang tinggi.
senses.nuances: 较书面的英语义项，如 nice distinction；不能按日常“不错”理解。[Merriam-Webster: nice](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/nice)

senses.zh_definition: 以令人满意或友善的方式；好好地。
senses.en_definition: In a pleasing or agreeable way.
senses.ms_definition: Dengan cara yang menyenangkan atau baik.
senses.nuances: 英语非正式副词用法；较正式的英语通常用 nicely。不是马来语副词。[Merriam-Webster: nice](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/nice)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场培训 / 英文评价用语说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam penilaian prestasi, ungkapan bahasa Inggeris "nice work" boleh digantikan dengan "hasil kerja yang baik".
dual_scenarios.zh: 在绩效评价中，英语表达“nice work”可换成马来语的“工作成果良好”。
dual_scenarios.en: In a performance appraisal, the English phrase "nice work" can be replaced with the Malay equivalent meaning "good work".

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 朋友称赞照片，含英语语码转换
spoken_features: nice 是插入马来语句子的英语评价词

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Gambar ni nice lah! Kau ambil kat mana?
messages.ms_standard: Gambar ini cantik! Awak mengambilnya di mana?
messages.zh: 这张照片真好看！你在哪儿拍的？
messages.en: This photo looks great! Where did you take it?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kat taman dekat rumah je. Aku dah hantar gambar lain dalam grup.
messages.ms_standard: Di taman berhampiran rumah sahaja. Saya sudah menghantar gambar lain dalam kumpulan sembang.
messages.zh: 就在家附近的公园。我已经把其他照片发到群里了。
messages.en: Just at the park near home. I've already sent the other photos to the group chat.

etymology.historical_story: Nice entered Middle English through Anglo-French, with earlier meanings connected to foolishness or silliness. Its ancestry reaches Latin nescius, meaning ignorant. That history makes its modern use for something pleasant or kind especially memorable: an everyday compliment preserves a word whose earlier associations were very different. [Merriam-Webster: nice](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/nice)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到漂亮照片就说 nice /naɪs/：把“看着舒服、感觉不错”的画面连在一起。形容人时改联想“友善体贴”，不要只记成“漂亮”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 朋友间的 nice lah 可表达轻松赞赏；对上司、客户或长辈，完整说明值得肯定之处通常更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 正式马来语按对象用 baik、bagus、cantik 或 menyenangkan。单独一句 nice 可能因语调显得敷衍或带讽刺。搭配栏为马来语对应表达；输入不足以支持 official 状态。
